records.title: Core Blueprint — Acquisition Sprint v1
records.description: Execute the first Core Blueprint customer-acquisition sprint for the WordPress Suite. Overseer remains canonical for strategy and commercial truth; Work tracks operational execution.

work_items.title: Review Acquisition Sprint v1 Overseer PR #5
work_items.description: Review the canonical acquisition sprint and confirm the operating plan before execution.

work_items.title: Audit free plugin Marketplace inventory
work_items.description: Identify which free plugins should be publicly downloadable now and verify listing, release and download-path state.

work_items.title: Complete Marketplace software listings for priority free plugins
work_items.description: Complete the public software identity, descriptions, version, requirements, documentation, support, release metadata and download CTA for each priority free plugin.

work_items.title: Build or verify canonical free plugin release ZIPs where required
work_items.description: Reuse valid canonical artifacts where possible; otherwise build the governed release ZIP and verify package/version/checksum identity.

work_items.title: Publish free plugin releases through Marketplace and Repository
work_items.description: Attach each correct release to its canonical software listing and verify that free delivery does not require a commercial entitlement.

work_items.title: Verify public free-download flow end-to-end
work_items.description: Test archive discovery, software single page, download action, package delivery and received ZIP for priority free plugins.

work_items.title: Review Marketplace archive template
work_items.description: Check hierarchy, spacing, free/commercial distinction, scanability and CTA clarity on the public software archive.

work_items.title: Review Marketplace single software template
work_items.description: Verify that listing data, release/version, requirements, documentation, changelog and free download CTA are presented coherently.

work_items.title: Apply bounded Marketplace archive and single UX polish if needed
work_items.description: Fix only concrete usability or consistency gaps found during the template review and re-run the relevant Marketplace regressions.

work_items.title: Build acquisition pipeline foundation
work_items.description: Set up Target → Contacted → Replied → Discovery → Demo → Qualified → Offer → Customer → Activated → Case Study and define the minimum prospect fields.

work_items.title: Select first five testimonial candidates
work_items.description: Select existing managed clients who can credibly speak about reliability, continuity, operational control, trust and responsibility.

work_items.title: Define testimonial outreach approach
work_items.description: Create an outcome-focused testimonial request that asks about the real management experience rather than a generic Core Blueprint review.

work_items.title: Define ICP qualification and discovery questions
work_items.description: Define qualification and discovery questions for both agency/operator prospects and organisations with serious digital responsibility.

work_items.title: Build Operator Pack 10–15 minute demo flow
work_items.description: Build a concise live flow from operational problem to Base/Backups, Hub/Beacon, central operations, governed updates and the commercial offer.

work_items.title: Build first qualified prospect batch
work_items.description: Select and qualify the first ten serious prospects before scaling the prospect list.

work_items.title: Start founder-led outreach batch #1
work_items.description: Send the first high-quality personalised outreach messages where the acquisition foundation and target fit are clear.

work_items.title: Review commercial E2E blockers
work_items.description: Identify only the technical, commerce, legal or support blockers that prevent an interested prospect from becoming a real customer.

work_items.title: Acquisition sprint daily review
work_items.description: Review active acquisition Work Items, replies, demos, blockers, overdue follow-ups and next actions; update the Work board and calendar.
